title: Execution profile
description: Everything that decides how a call is made. Receipts record a hash of this file plus the observed CLI version and model; any drift makes the receipt UNKNOWN.

family.description: Model family used for cross-family checks, e.g. anthropic, openai, qwen, llama.

reasoning_effort.description: Passed explicitly. Both CLIs default high if unset.

version.description: Exact version string the receipt is valid for, as printed by --version.

endpoint.description: openai_http only. Base URL ending in /v1.

sandbox.description: codex_cli only. danger-full-access is deliberately not allowed.

timeout_s.description: Hard wall-clock limit enforced by the orchestrator. A timeout with no output is a failover trigger.
